privacyTitle: Built like macOS. Zero root helpers. Zero cloud.
privacySubtitle: Monny is written in pure Swift and SwiftUI directly on top of Mach, IOKit, and Apple's native frameworks. No background daemons running as root, no analytics SDKs, and no server between your Mac and your tools.
privacyRule1Desc: Runs as a standard user app — never asks for sudo or installs LaunchDaemons.
privacyRule2Desc: Uses macOS 26.4+ native battery controls instead of risky SMC write hacks.
privacyRule3Desc: Reads existing local sign-in state and talks directly to providers from your Mac.
privacyRule4Desc: Every DMG ships with published SHA-256 checksums and cryptographic update signatures.

faqSubtitle: Everything about signing, battery limits, AI provider privacy, and hardware support.
faq1Q: Why does macOS show a warning on first launch?
faq1A: Monny is free, open-source software built and distributed via GitHub Releases without a paid Apple Developer notarization fee. If Gatekeeper prompts on first launch, run the Homebrew cask install or clear the quarantine attribute with xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Monny.app after verifying SHA256SUMS.txt.
faq2Q: How does battery charge limit work without a root helper?
faq2A: On macOS 26.4 and newer, Monny uses Apple's built-in charge-limit capability directly, so it never needs root privileges, kernel extensions, or privileged SMC write helpers. On earlier macOS 15 versions, Monny still tracks battery health, cycle count, wattage, and cell temperatures read-only.
faq3Q: How does Monny track 22 AI coding tools safely?
faq3A: Monny inspects your local tool configurations and queries provider usage endpoints directly from your Mac. Nothing passes through a third-party proxy, nothing is stored in the cloud, and you can enable or disable individual providers at any time in Settings.
faq4Q: Does Monny work on Mac Studio, Mac mini, or iMac?
faq4A: Yes. On desktop Macs without a battery, Monny automatically hides battery-only controls while giving you full CPU, memory, disk, network, listening ports, SMC thermal sensors, and AI quota monitoring.
faq5A: Monny includes Ed25519-signed Sparkle updates so you can update in one click from the app, or manage upgrades via Homebrew with brew upgrade --cask monny.
